title: Solar, Battery and EV Charger Install
review:
Solar, Battery and EV Charger Install.

When looking at Solar there are a lots of regional and national providers out there but so pleased I choose Renegade Solar for my project (16 panels, 2x9.6kwh batteries, 8kw inverter and an EV charger). Ash and the team are great. Really customer focused and work with you to find the best solution that works for you and your home. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend and great to see local independent businesses able to get it so right.
